enum_result: enum E{Empty,Value{n:i64}}recursive fn make()->E.Empty{var x:E.Empty=default<E.Empty>();return x;}fn main(){let x:E.Empty=make();assert(x .== &x);print("enum_result");}
enum_inline: enum E{Empty,Value{n:i64}}fn same(a:E.Empty)->E.Empty{return a;}fn main(){var a:E.Empty=default<E.Empty>();let b:E.Empty=same(a);assert(&a .!= &b);print("enum_inline");}
enum_callback: enum E{Empty,Value{n:i64}}fn apply<F>(a:E.Empty)->E.Empty{return F(a);}fn main(){var a:E.Empty=default<E.Empty>();let b:E.Empty=apply(a){x:E.Empty=>x};assert(&a .!= &b);print("enum_callback");}
enum_order: enum E{Empty,Value{n:i64}}var calls:i64=0;recursive fn make()->E.Empty{calls++;return default<E.Empty>();}recursive fn later()->i64{assert(calls==1);calls++;return 55;}recursive fn take(a:E.Empty,n:i64)->i64{assert(a .== &a);return n;}fn main(){assert(take(make(),later())==55&&calls==2);print("enum_order");}
